newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ridley says unlikely to win White bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ridley says unlikely to win White bid.

text.p: Stockfeed group Ridley Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it was unlikely to succeed with its takeover offer for maltster Joe White Maltings Ltd, which values the company at around A$98 million.

"Our final offer of A$5.30 per share is set to expire on 8 November and is unlikely to be successful in delivering to us control if Joe White," chairman John Keniry told the annual meeting. "Despite these events we plan to continue to seek ways to enter the malting business other than through Joe White."
On Monday, Ridley said it would not raise its offer. Ridley currently owns about 18 percent of Joe White.
Ridley is offering A$5.30 a share plus 14 cents a share dividend. Joe White shares last traded on Tuesday when they fell 10 cents to A$5.50.
